condition: With the oracledb client, isConnectionError does not recognize NJS-500/NJS-521 errors, so broken connections are not evicted from the pool after an Oracle outage.
workaround: Patch lib/dialects/oracle/utils.js isConnectionError to include 'NJS-500' and 'NJS-521', or configure pool validation (e.g. a custom pool.validate) to discard dead connections.
